title: The sealed door
starting_code: # Stand before the arch, cast zelim, and walk through.
hints: You need to move left to the path and then up to the arch before casting.
Use the `cast` method to cast your spell and break the glowing seal.
After the seal is broken, use the `move_up` method to walk through.
intro: That arched gate in the low wall is sealed by a glowing rune. Move over to stand right before it, cast your new spell to break the seal, and walk through to the mark beyond!
outro: Amazing! Your very first spell worked perfectly and broke the seal.
learned: Now you know how to cast a spell with your wand, and that *zelim* breaks a seal.
